asked.item: Claude only posts when typed to
How to post every morning automatically

verdict.reason: The FAQ entry directly answers how to make posting automatic with a schedule.

steps.text: A regular Claude chat acts only when you send a message, so posting stays manual.
Set up a Claude Code Routine (a scheduled agent) that runs your Blotato posting workflow on a recurring schedule, for example every morning.
Or use a Managed Agent to run the posting workflow in the cloud on a schedule.
Alternatively, run the same flow from n8n or Make.com with a schedule trigger and the official Blotato nodes.
